name: Fresh Peach Thick Milkshake
whyItWorks: Combining whole dairy ice cream with high-FODMAP real peach chunks creates a double digestive challenge: lactose induces gas and bloating, while stone fruit fructose can trigger rapid loose stools.
prepOrOrderInstructions: High Lactose & FODMAP Warning: Consume only small sips during remission with lactase enzymes, or choose a dairy-free beverage.
